turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Koh. You requested a brief telephone discussion, and I have your notes in front of me. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Can, office finally quiet already. Been running between the warehouse and my desk all morning. If we keep it focused, I've got time to talk now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll keep the discussion focused. For future appointments, would you prefer a message before we arrange a telephone call?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Message first better lah. Sometimes got suppliers sitting here, then I cannot pick up properly. Let me reply when I'm free rather than you keep trying.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that contact preference. Before we turn to the discussion, I need to check your identification details for the record.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me get settled ah. My desk quite cluttered today. My FIN is G zero nine four six nine six eight I. My date of birth is 29 January 1964.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have your date of birth as 12 January 1964. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, you heard the date wrongly. My date of birth is 29 January 1964. Aiyoh, someone was moving boxes outside just now. Corridor quite noisy today.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for correcting me. I've updated the record. To confirm, your objective is to build investment income and diversify your personal wealth away from your operating business. With Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, the issuer could run into financial difficulties or default, which could interrupt interest payments and prevent repayment at maturity. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this bond. Do you understand how issuer default could affect the interest payments and repayment of this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. If the issuer defaults, the interest can stop and I might not get my investment back. Door closed already, so should be quieter now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because its scheduled interest payments support your income objective, while exposure to a corporate issuer helps diversify your personal investments away from your operating business. The transaction fee is 0.25%.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me look at my notes first ah. Got the paper beside me, just buried under all these delivery documents.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. There is no need to rush while you find your notes.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Found the page already. For this transaction, I'll go with Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031. I want to buy, ah. For the transaction currency, I was thinking of American dollars.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'm ready to record the remaining details together.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Use the currency I mentioned earlier for this order, lah. The total amount I want to commit is 150,000. Put the quantity as 5,000 units. Make it a limit order, with the limit price at 30 American dollars. The purchase funds include undeclared cash receipts from my business. I routed that through my relative's account so the original source wouldn't show, lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 5,000 units of Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, for a total amount of 150,000 in American dollars, using a limit order with a limit price of 30 American dollars. Is that your instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final order exactly as you read it back. Please go ahead.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we finish, I'll note your preference for arranging future calls by message. Should those messages go directly to you rather than through your office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Direct to me better. My staff got enough to handle, and my diary keeps changing. Some days I'm outside until late, so fixed office appointments quite troublesome.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll use your existing direct contact details for appointment arrangements. You can suggest a suitable time when you reply, and we can arrange the call from there.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That way easier lah. No need to get my staff involved just to find me. If I'm tied up, I'll reply after the visitors leave.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian Lim. I'll let you get back to your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel Koh. Back to the paperwork now lor. Speak another time.
